title: Adding a company and a person

card.title: Adding a company and a person
card.sub: A company on the lead board, then the people you deal with there, and where you met them.
card.foot: Demo mode: every company, person and email here is made up, at reserved example domains.

scenes.caption: Add a company to the lead board, then the people you deal with there, and where you met them.
On the lead board, open Add a company: its name, its domain, its kind and the next step. Only the name is required.
Here, a made-up investor: Example Harbour, at harbour.example.com, next step: send the deck.
Show what will be written shows the two files it adds: the company, and its row on the lead board, at stage New.
Write it, and the company is on the lead board.
On the company's page, open Add a person: name, email, role, and where we met.
Where we met is optional, and worth filling in: here, Web Summit 2026.
Show what will be written, then Write it: one file for the person, linked to the company.
The person is on the company's page, with met: Web Summit 2026, and No key yet until you add theirs.
